description: ADCETRIS is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory CD30+ Hodgkin lymphoma (HL): (i) following ASCT, or (ii) following at least two prior therapies when ASCT or multi-agent chemotherapy is not a treatment option.
